name: Greymon
look: a hunched orange tyrant with blue tiger stripes, a brown skull helmet with a nose horn and two side horns, an open jaw full of white fangs, big white claws and a long striped tail
entry: A giant dinosaur Digimon whose skull is armoured with a helmet of hardened bone. Its Mega Flame melts rock; even a herd of the strongest beasts scatters when it roars.
how: Wild: rare in badlands, savannas and hills.
Evolves into MetalGreymon at level 35, learning Giga Destroyer.
Evolves into Aero V-dramon at level 35.
